cases.title: Medical necessity appeal: CGRP antagonist for migraine prevention
cases.one_line: Denied for missing proof of prior treatment failure; the record contains all of it.
cases.expected_banner: All 4 requirements under §3.1 are supported by the record. Ready for staff review.

cases.title: Medical necessity appeal: home health after hip fracture surgery
cases.one_line: Denied for missing homebound documentation; the record supports a different policy pathway instead.
cases.expected_banner: Evidence missing for homebound certification (§3.1(c)). Recommend appealing under §3.3, home-based care in place of a facility admission: 3 of 3 requirements supported.

cases.title: Medical necessity appeal: MRI of the lumbar spine
cases.one_line: Denied for incomplete conservative therapy; the record shows 4 of 6 weeks and no exception applies.
cases.expected_banner: Evidence incomplete for §3.1(b): 4 of 6 weeks of physical therapy documented. No alternative basis is supported by this record. Obtain documentation for the remaining 2 weeks before appealing.
